sentences.en: The mob gathered round the car like so many flies.
sentences.zh: 一群暴徒像苍蝇一样围在汽车周围。

sentences.en: Her husband was an accountant who worked for the mob.
sentences.zh: 她的丈夫是一名会计师，在黑手党工作。

sentences.en: The angry mob overturned cars and smashed storefront windows.
sentences.zh: 愤怒的暴徒推翻了汽车，砸碎了商店橱窗。

phrases.zh: 快闪族（指临时聚集进行某种活动的一群人）

senses.zh: 暴民，暴徒；民众；乌合之众
大举包围，围攻；蜂拥进入
